name: FileUpload
description: A file upload area with drag-and-drop support, click-to-browse, file type filtering, size limit display, multiple file support, and preview list.

maxSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes (0 = no limit)

multiple.description: Whether multiple files can be selected

disabled.description: Whether the upload area is disabled

icon.description: Custom icon displayed in the drop zone

title.description: Custom title text for the drop zone

description.description: Custom description text below the title

filesSelected.description: Fired when files are selected or dropped

fileRemoved.description: Fired when a file is removed from the preview list
